judgments.reason: Dataset authors match the paper's authors exactly, and the dataset DOI is this paper. It reports the supporting study with 12 novice users doing two-class motor imagery BCI, matching the 12 BCI-naive subjects.
judgments.paper_title: Autocalibration and Recurrent Adaptation: Towards a Plug and Play Online ERD-BCI
judgments.paper_venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS; it is not a paper describing the BNCI 2015-001 motor imagery dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard extending BIDS to EEG, used to format this dataset; it does not describe the BNCI 2015-001 motor imagery recordings.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
